description: Runs a knockout tournament between up to sixteen signals: each trigger draws a random winner of every one-on-one match until one signal is left.

params.text: Starts a new contest, drawing a fresh set of winners.
Inverts the result, so every loser of a match becomes its winner and every winner becomes its loser.

inputs.text: One of the sixteen signals entered in the tournament.
A trigger starts a new contest, drawing a fresh set of winners.
A trigger inverts the result of every match.

outputs.text: Carries the winner of one first-round match between two of the inputs.
Carries the winner of one second-round match between two first-round winners.
Carries the winner of one third-round match between two second-round winners.
Carries the signal that won all four rounds.

notes: a green light marks a winning signal, a red one an inverted state, and white lights show the weighting in Quantum mode.
menu: Mode — CV / audio routes the winning signal straight through, Sample & hold captures one sample of each input on a trigger, and Quantum mixes every input by weight instead of picking one.
